summary: Implemented a deterministic, durable, transport-neutral External Delivery Receipt model (src/pcae/core/delivery_receipt.py) built entirely on top of the verified Delivery Pipeline (134E.6/134E.6V). Records one logical delivery, its ordered physical attempts, per-unit outcomes, retries, partial delivery, authorization outcomes, and correction/supersession relationships. Deterministic receipt/attempt identity via canonical JSON array hashing (never delimiter-joined strings, per 134E.6V's own repaired discipline). Last-attempt-wins aggregate unit accounting across retries (no double-counting). Explicit logical-vs-physical exactly-once distinction -- one receipt lineage/final state logically, but physical attempts are never claimed to be exactly-once. Ambiguous external outcomes representable without auto-retry. Retry lineage structurally rejects changed rendering/destination/adapter/purpose/policy under the same lineage (all baked into logical_delivery_id). Correction/supersession implemented as a purely additive overlay with its own distinct receipt identity -- finalized receipts are deeply immutable (frozen dataclasses plus MappingProxyType-wrapped nested mappings) and never mutated or overwritten. File-backed persistence (DeliveryReceiptStore) reuses Phase 93C's audit-record atomic-write/digest-verification convention: temp-file + os.replace, digest verified on every load, fails closed on stale/duplicate/post-finalization writes. Directly addressed 134E.6V's NON-BLOCKING observation via bounded, explicit-pattern diagnostic redaction (never a raw exception representation). Storage layout grouped by logical delivery identity, never adapter-specific naming. 110 new focused tests (all 110 required areas) pass; 760 combined 134E.2-134E.7 regression tests pass; notification/authorization/finalization/canonical-evidence regression suite (374 tests) pass; fast_green 4389/4390 passing this run (one pre-existing, unrelated failure confirmed via clean-checkout reproduction). No production receipt artifact created; no PFN-001 integration; module remains fully isolated. 134E.7V not begun.
